discovery_mechanism: Broker-based topic subscription and retained session state
communication_model: Publish/subscribe with retained message and offline session support
cross_platform_support: Windows, Linux, macOS, embedded clients through mature MQTT libraries
qos_support: QoS 0/1/2, retained messages, persistent sessions, last will
reliability: High for QoS 1/2; broker persistence and offline queue behavior depend on broker configuration
realtime: Suitable for soft real-time telemetry and command delivery, not deterministic hard real-time control
transport_support: Typically TCP/TLS; some brokers also support WebSocket and other transports
ecosystem_maturity: Very mature IoT ecosystem with broad broker and client support
